themes.description: Covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user experience of the application.
Covers requests or feedback related to learning resources, trading education, and guidance on using the platform.
Covers feedback and complaints regarding the design, functionality, and convenience of specific features within the application.
Reviews or requests related to educational content, trading tutorials, or guidance on how to use the platform for trading.
Feedback on the design, layout, and functionality of specific features within the application, including changes to existing features.
Covers feedback related to the general ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall positive experience with the application's interface and functionality.
Feedback or requests related to learning resources, tutorials, or guidance on how to trade and use investment tools.
Suggestions or requests for new features, functionalities, or enhancements to existing tools within the application.
General negative opinions or criticisms about the brokerage industry, market practices, or the perceived impact of such applications, rather than specific app issues.
Covers issues related to trading rules, margin policies, stock pledging, and asset management mechanisms.
Concerns or suggestions related to specific functionalities, tools, or features within the application.
Reviews related to alleged fraudulent activities, scams, manipulated data, or unauthorized money deductions and refusal to process legitimate withdrawals.
Suggestions for new features, improvements, or comparisons with competitor offerings to enhance the platform's capabilities.
This theme covers issues related to how funds are managed, provided, or deducted, especially in specific trading facilities like Margin Trading Facility (MTF).
This theme covers issues where user funds are blocked, inaccessible, or unavailable for trading or other intended uses within the platform.
Covers requests for new trading functionalities, missing order types, or enhancements to existing trading tools.
Concerns or feedback related to the frequency, size, or necessity of app updates.
Suggestions for new features or improvements to existing platform functionalities.
Reviews expressing general satisfaction or dissatisfaction with the app's overall quality and user experience.
This theme covers complaints about complex, lengthy, or difficult processes for account setup, verification, or other administrative tasks.
Feedback related to login issues, account security, multi-factor authentication options, and general accessibility to user accounts.
This theme covers issues and suggestions related to account login, security, and requests for new trading or platform features.
This theme covers feedback related to the app's user interface design, navigation, ease of use, and overall user experience.
Concerns related to the app's layout, navigation, design, or the placement and discoverability of features.
This theme covers issues or questions related to account setup, identity verification, bank account linking, and other onboarding processes.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability, success rate, or range of investment products like IPOs, mutual funds, or other securities.
This theme covers requests or feedback related to the availability of different languages within the app or for communication.
Covers feedback related to the app's design, ease of use, navigation, overall quality, and general satisfaction.
Feedback or requests related to the availability of specific investment products, asset classes, or foreign investment opportunities.
Issues related to downloading, installing, logging in, or generally accessing the application.
